attributes.title: Sylva
attributes.lede: A moss world, live cards punched into it, toured by a camera that never stops.

lesson.concept: A camera path and its response are different things
lesson.why: The tour supplies desired framing while cascaded camera and aim responses shape how it reaches that framing. The host renders the scene; its chase model is not a replacement for a Choreo score.
lesson.experiment: Compare Dream glide and Brisk tracking around a change of direction. Watch whether position and aim arrive together and whether the subject remains readable.
lesson.pitfall: Calling a history-dependent chased frame an exact seek is misleading; recording needs a defined reconstruction policy.
lesson.combine: Combine with Film transport only after defining how camera state is reconstructed at a requested timestamp.
